Once upon a time there was a little girl named Lily. She lived with her mom and dad in a big, white house.

One day Lily's mom told Lily that it was time to wash the chair. Lily didn't want to wash the chair, so she started to pout.

"Come on, Lily," her mom said in a gentle voice. "It won't take long and it will be a graceful job once it's done."

Lily grumbled a bit more but then she eventually got to work. She got the wet cloth and started to rub it on the chair. Then, she got another cloth and started to dry the chair.

By the end of it, the chair looked so beautiful! Lily smiled and was filled with pride.

"Now that is a graceful job!" her mom said as she beamed.

Lily was so proud of herself and she couldn't wait to show everyone the beautiful chair.

The mommy was getting ready to go outside. She put on her dress and shoes.

"Mama," said the three year old, "I want to dress too so I can come outside with you!" 

"That's a great idea!" said Mama. "Let's go to your room and find something for you to wear."

The three year old picked out a bright yellow dress that she liked. She quickly got dressed and put on some shoes. 

"Do you want to go for a jog with me?" Mama asked. 

The three year old thought about it for a moment and then smiled. "Yes! Let's go for a jog!"

Mama was impressed by her intelligent decision. She took the girl's hand in hers and they began running together. 

They jogged around the block, laughing and talking the entire way. After a while, the 3 year old got tired and they stopped to walk. 

"That was a lot of fun!" she said, and Mama agreed. 

The three year old was very happy with her intelligent choice to go for a jog with Mama. She knew she would never forget this special morning.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Molly. She lived in a nice red house with her family. One day she decided to go for a swim in the lake behind her house.

When she reached the lake, Molly saw something red in the water. It was a ghost! Molly was scared and started to cry.

Suddenly, the ghost said: "Don't be scared, Molly. I'm friendly. I'm just here to make the lake more fun by splashing around."

Molly was still scared, but she was also curious. She stepped a little closer and the ghost said: "Come in and splash with me!"

Molly thought for a moment and made a brave decision. She jumped in the lake and began to splash with the red ghost. They had so much fun!

When it was time to go home, Molly thanked the ghost. The ghost smiled and said: "You're welcome. Come back anytime and we can play together again!" Molly smiled and went home, feeling much braver than before.

Once upon a time there were two friends - Jack and Jill. They were out for a walk in the park. Suddenly, Jack saw a vase on the ground. He asked Jill, "What is that?"

Jill said, "It's a vase."

Jack ordered Jill to pick it up and put it somewhere safe. So Jill picked up the vase and looked at it closely. She was very sad.

Jack asked, "Why are you so sad?"

Jill replied, "I think someone dropped it, and it's broken."

Jack said, "I'm sure they would be glad if they could have it back. Let's ask them if they know who owns it."

So they searched and searched until they finally found the vase's owner, a little old lady.

When she saw the vase, she was so happy and hugged them both, thanking them for finding it.

Jack and Jill were glad that their search had been successful and the little old lady was happy too. Everyone was happy in the end.

Once there was a girl, her name was Amy. She was so very creative, she loved to make things.

One day, Amy wanted to make something special. She went to her room and got all her left over bits and pieces from her projects; Lego, jellybeans and paint.

"How can I change this into something amazing?!" she thought. Then she had an idea.

She took the Lego, and mixed it with the jellybeans and paint. She played around for hours, and she made a very cool surprise.

Amy ran to her mum and dad, and showed them what she had made. Her mum and dad smiled.

"That's so wonderful!" said mum.

Amy was so proud of her creativity and what she had been able to do. She had changed all her leftovers into something amazing.

Once upon a time there was a brave little girl. She had big bright eyes and a smile that filled the room. One day, she wanted to explore her world.

"I'm going outside," the brave little girl said proudly. 

Her mother smiled. "Make sure you always stay close," she said.

The brave little girl nodded and winked before running out the door. 

The brave little girl filled her day with exploring, picking flowers and waving at the birds in the sky.  She was having so much fun. 

Then, she saw some big kids playing in the park. She didn't know them but she was brave. She waved and said, "Hi! Can I play too?"

The big kids were surprised but smiled back. "Sure," they said.

The brave little girl smiled and filled the rest of the day playing with her new friends.

One day a little rabbit was walking through the woods. He bumped into a big bear. The bear said, "What do you want?" The little rabbit was so scared, he stuttered, "I...I...I was just walking through."

The bear got angry. He said, "You must yield this bottle to me, or else!" The little rabbit started to cry. He didn't want to give the bear the bottle, but he had no choice. He reluctantly gave it to the bear.

The bear took the bottle and smiled. He said, "You are so selfish, giving me only one bottle." The rabbit was relieved. He thought, "If I had given him more bottles, it would have been even worse!" 

The bear said, "Next time, think twice before refusing another bear's request." The rabbit nodded in agreement. He then bowed and walked away quickly, grateful that he had been spared by the selfish bear.

Once there was a little girl called Daisy. She was three years old and loved to explore. One day she was on an adventure in the park. She noticed an old camera lying on the ground next to a tree. She picked it up and decided to take it home.

When Daisy arrived home with the camera, her mummy was very surprised. She asked Daisy where she got it from. Daisy told her mummy about the park and the old camera.

Mummy thought the camera was broken but then she found a battery and put it into the camera. To her delight, the camera worked!

Mummy was very grateful to Daisy. She said "the camera fits in perfectly with Daisy's adventure kit. Now you can take photos of all your adventures."

Daisy was very happy and thanked her mummy. She was very excited to go back to the park and go on many more adventures with her camera.

Once upon a time there was a club. It was a big and special club. Inside was a very expensive toy. 

One day, a little boy called Jack was visiting. He was only three years old and was very excited. He asked if he could play with the expensive toy. But his mum said no, it was too expensive.

Jack snuck away from his mum. He ran to the toy and started playing. His mum stopped looking for him and the toy started to disappear. Jack wondered what was happening. 

"Mum, where did the toy go?" Jack asked, very confused.

"That was magic," his mum replied. "The toy disappeared. That is why it was so expensive."

Jack nodded his head. He was excited by the magic. He promised himself he would never touch an expensive toy again.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Sam. He loved to explore. Today, he wanted to go for a walk in the woods to find a creek. So he said goodbye to his parents and started walking.

On his way, Sam heard a noise coming from the trees. When he looked between the branches he saw an amazing sight. A group of frogs were jumping from stone to stone in the creek.

Sam wanted to stay and watch but he didn't want to delay his adventure, so he said goodbye to the frogs and continued his walk. 

Later, he came across a tall mountain and said, "Wow, that's amazing!" He was quite happy and excited. 

He followed the creek until he reached his parents house. When he walked inside he said, "Mummy, look I found a creek! It was amazing!"

His Mummy smiled and said, "I'm glad you had a great adventure, Sam."

Once upon a time, there was a very lonely cloud. Every day he would look down from the sky and see the happy people on the ground smiling and laughing. He felt so lonely and wished he had someone to talk to. 

One day, it started to rain. The lonely cloud wasn't so lonely anymore because now he could talk to the people below. He felt happy to make them laugh and smile. As he rained he said, "Hi everyone! I'm a lonely cloud and I'm here to visit you!"

Suddenly, a little girl below shouted, "Look Mama! A talking cloud!"

The little girl and her mama stared up at the cloud astonished. 

The cloud asked, "Do you want to be my friend?"

The little girl nodded and ran over to her mom.

"Mama, can I be friends with the cloud? Please!?"

The mom smiled and said, "Of course you can. Just reach up and touch your nose to his raindrops and make a wish."

The little girl closed her eyes and did what her mom said. When she opened them, the cloud was gone. But the little girl kept her friendship with the lonely cloud in her heart.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny who lived in a big meadow. She was playing with her friends when suddenly the sun disappeared from the sky! The bunny was scared and asked her friends: "Where did the sun go?"

Her friends all said they didn't know, so the bunny had to go look for it. She hopped around the meadow, but couldn't find the sun anywhere. Suddenly she saw a rare rainbow in the sky!

"I know!" she shouted. "The sun must have gone past the rainbow!"

So she hopped towards the rainbow, but as she got closer, the sun disappeared behind a cloud. The bunny was sad and thought she had lost the sun forever.

Just then, a warm breeze touched her face and the cloud slowly moved away. There it was! The sun was there, shining brighter than before! The bunny was so happy and the meadow lit up with its warmth. From that day on, the bunny never lost the sun again.

Once upon a time, there was a small girl called Sally. She wanted to see the big world, but her mum wanted to prevent it.

"Mum, why can't I explore the world?" Sally asked.
"Because, you are very young and still need to learn a lot" said Mum.

"But I'm nearly 4 years old, I know a lot already," said Sally.

Mum smiled and said, "You know a lot, but you don't know everything. There are still some things that you don't understand. It's better to be safe and stay under the watchful eye of an adult."

Sally felt a little sad, so Mum added, "Besides, it's ignorant to think that you already know everything. When you're older, you can explore the world as much as you want. Until then, be patient okay?"

Sally nodded and gave her mum a big hug. She understood that even though it wasn't fair, all the things her mum said were to keep her safe.

John was walking in the park. He looked down and saw a strip on the ground. He thought it was so fine! He picked it up and decided to take it home with him. 

On the way, he saw his friend Mary. Mary asked, "What do you have there?" 

John said, "I found this strip and Iâ€™m taking it home." Mary smiled and said, "That looks so fine! Can I have it?"

Mary thanked him and happily took the strip. She said "Thank you! I'll take good care of it. Bye!"

John smiled and waved goodbye. He was glad that he was able to make his friend happy. He kept walking and looking forward to getting home.

Once upon a time, there was a kid named Joe. Joe was three years old and was very polite. One day, he wanted to open the cup he found on the ground. When he opened it, he saw something shiny inside. 

He took it out and asked his mummy, "What is this?"

Mummy looked at it and said, "It is a coin, Joe. It looks like a penny. You can keep it and show it to your friends."

Joe was so excited and thought, "This is great! Now I can buy some ice cream!" 

He quickly put the coin inside the cup, closed it and ran off to get his ice cream.

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a funny little mouse called Sam. Sam had the most creative ideas, but no one paid much attention to them.

One day, Sam decided to do something about it. He grabbed a big box and started to squeeze it with all his might. His tiny little paws managed to create the most amazing sound.

A nearby pigeon heard the sound and was so surprised that it asked, "What was that sound?"

Sam grinned and replied, "It's my creative idea! I'm using the box to make music!"

The pigeon was so impressed that soon all the animals started to join in. Soon, the forest was full of funny little animals squeezing boxes, creating the most wonderful music. 

Everyone had a wonderful time and Sam finally felt appreciated for his creative talent.

As they danced, a surprise appeared. It was a magical, independent flower. Its petals were so beautiful and colorful that they danced around.

Once upon a time, a quiet farmer lived in a small house. He loved the outdoors, so he worked hard in his garden. Every day he would tie his plants carefully to the fence to help them grow.

One warm summer day, the farmer was in his garden tying some new plants when he heard a voice asking for help. "Hello, can you help me?" asked the voice. The farmer looked down and saw a small bug who couldn't reach the top of a plant.

The farmer smiled and said, "Yes, I can help." He bent down, grabbed some string and gently tied it around the plant. Then he helped the bug climb inside the loop so it could reach the top.

The bug thanked the farmer and said, "Thank you so much! You are very kind." The farmer said, "You're welcome," and continued on with his work.

The next day, the farmer found the little bug at the same spot, this time with some of its bug friends. The farmer smiled and waved before getting back to work. He knew the little bug was in good hands!

One day, Bob the whale was swimming in the ocean. He felt something wet on his back and knew he needed to clean himself. He stopped to take a break and called to his friend Jimmy the starfish. 

"Jimmy," he said, "I think I need help cleaning myself." 

Jimmy smiled and said, "I'm here to help! Let me take a look." 

Jimmy looked at Bob's back and saw that it was very thin. He knew that he could help Bob clean it.

Jimmy swam around Bob, spraying water everywhere. He rubbed Bob's back with a soft cloth until it was clean and shiny. 

When Jimmy was finished, Bob smiled. "Thanks for helping me clean, Jimmy," he said. 

Jimmy said, "It's my pleasure. It's important to keep yourself nice and clean!" 

Bob thanked Jimmy again and the two of them continued to swim around, happy that Bob was now clean again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Jane. Jane was three years old and very excited. She wanted to bring something special to school to show her friends.

On the way to school, Jane spotted something very shiny in a store window. When she got closer, she saw it was a big, amazing rubber ball! She couldn't resist bringing it with her.

When Jane got to school, her friends were so excited to see the biggest and most amazing rubber ball ever. They all wanted to play with it! 

Jane said, "Hey friends! Who wants to play with my ball?" 
Her friends all said at once, "Me! Me!" So they went off to the playground to play with Jane's amazing rubber ball. 

The kids had a wonderful time together and they all had lots of fun. Jane brought the most amazing rubber ball to school, and it was a wonderful day!

Once there was a little girl named Emmy. She was three years old and loved to explore. 

One day, Emmy wanted to buy something special. She asked her mom for some money, and her mom gave her some to buy a toy.

Emmy went to the store and looked around. She saw a big toy that made a lot of noise! Emmy thought it was so cool and wanted to buy it. 

So Emmy put the toy in her basket. But her Mom said, "No Emmy, that one is too noisy!"

Emmy asked, "What can I buy, Mommy?"
 
Her mom answered, "Why don't you buy a quieter toy, like this one? This one is safe and it won't make too much noise." Emmy liked that idea. 

So she put the quieter toy in her basket and bought it. Then she took it home and played with it all day.

Mark was pretending he was a tiger. He growled like a tiger and waved his arms like a tiger. He was so good at pretending that he even forgot he was really Mark.

His mother came in to his playroom and said, "Mark! What are you doing?" Mark replied, "I'm pretending I'm a tiger!"

Mark's mom looked around the room and saw a thick blanket on the floor. Then she said to Mark, "Let's pretend the blanket is a jungle! You can be the tiger and I'll be the monkey!"

Mark said with excitement, "Let's do it!"

So both Mark and his mom pretended their blanket was a jungle. They hopped and jumped around the room like monkeys and tigers. They pretended for a long time, playing different roles and having lots of fun.

Eventually, Mark's mom said, "Let's stop pretending now, Mark. It's time for dinner!"

So Mark put his tiger costume away, gave his mom a big hug, and said, "Thanks for playing with me!"

Once upon a time there was a car. The car was old and rusty. One day it got so rusty that it rot. The car was sad and angry. 

The car said to a nearby tree, "This is so stupid! I don't want to rot!" 

The tree said, "But that's how cars get when they're old. You need to accept it."

The car replied, "No! I wish I could still drive around like I used to."

The tree shook its leaves sadly. "I know. But life isn't always fair. You will just have to rot and accept your fate."

And that's how the car learned to accept its fate and rot away in peace.

Once upon a time, there was a turkey who loved to laugh. He giggled, cackled and guffawed all the time.

One day, the turkey was feeling bored. He couldn't seem to make himself happy. He wanted to laugh. But, how?

He went up to a little girl named Lucy who was playing nearby.

He asked her, "Can you help me laugh? I'm bored of being so quiet."

Lucy thought for a moment, then smiled.

"Yes! Hop on my back, and I'll take you for a ride," she said.

The turkey happily hopped on Lucy's back and off they went, whooping and laughing all the way.

When they returned, the turkey had been able to laugh again. He thanked Lucy for the good time and together, they laughed and laughed until the sun set.

Once there was a bunny who loved to hop. He liked hopping all around, especially in the sunshine. One day, while he was hopping, he saw a harmless pear nearby. He had never seen one before, so he hopped over to take a closer look.

He stood up on his hind legs and sniffed the pear. It smelled sweet and yummy. He wanted to take a bite, but he was a little bit scared. He called out to his friend, a bird named Chirpy, who was sitting near by in a tree.

"Chirpy, do you think this pear is harmless?" the bunny asked.

"Yes, I think it is!" Chirpy said. "You should take a bite!"

So the bunny hopped over to the pear and took a big bite. It was the best thing he had ever tasted! He hopped in circles, as he was so happy.

After that day, the bunny hopped over to that pear tree every day. It always had new, delicious pears to try. He felt so lucky to have such a harmless and tasty snack.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Bob. He wanted to go on a march. He was so excited, he put on his warmest coat. 
Bob thought, "What kind of day will it be?" 
Bob opened the door and saw that it was icy outside. He said, "Oh no! It's so cold. I wonder if I should go?"

Just then, Bob saw his friend, Joe. Joe was also looking out the door. Joe asked, "Where ya goin' Bob?" Bob said, "I was thinkin' 'bout takin' a march." Joe smiled and said, "That's a great idea! Let's go!"

So, Bob and Joe went on a march. They had so much fun crunching the icy snow with their feet. Bob and Joe laughed as they slipped and slid all the way down the street. 

When they got back home, Bob and Joe thought it was the best march ever. They had lots of fun and even made a wish when they saw a shooting star in the night sky.

Once there was a plane that liked to spin in the sky. It was really fun and interesting!
One day, while it was spinning around, it saw a little bird on the ground. 
"Hey little bird," said the plane, "Do you want to join me and spin together?" 
The bird replied, "Oh yes! That sounds like lots of fun!"
So the plane and the bird began to spin together around the sky.
They went faster and faster and laughed in delight. They spun so much that they turned the whole sky into a rainbow! 
When their spinning was done, the plane winked at the bird and flew away. The bird smiled and said, "That was so playful and interesting!" 

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Jane. Jane was very brave and had a big goal. She wanted to shrink a big mountain to the size of a tiny hill.

A magical fairy heard about Jane's goal. The fairy was so grateful that she came down from the clouds to help Jane.

The fairy said to Jane, "I can help you to shrink the mountain! We need to make a special wish. Are you ready?

Jane was ready and closed her eyes. She imagined the mountain shrinking. Suddenly, a beautiful rainbow appeared in the sky and the mountain grew smaller and smaller until it was the size of a tiny hill.

Jane was so surprised that her wish had come true. She looked at the fairy and said, "Thank you! I'm so very grateful."

The fairy smiled and said, "Your bravery has made this possible, so your wish and goal have come true!"

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Jack. One day, Jack was helping his mom do the chores and he was given a special job. His mom said, "Jack, I need you to find the hidden leak in the kitchen and clean it up". 

Jack was excited to help his mom. He went to the kitchen and searched high and low, but he couldn't find the leak anywhere. He went to his mom and said, "Mommy, I can't find the leak". His mom smiled and said, "Look behind the curtains, Jack. That's usually where it's hiding". 

Jack looked behind the curtains and sure enough, he found the leak. He quickly got a rag and cleaned up the mess. His mom thanked him for doing such a good job, and gave him a hug. Jack was very happy to have helped his mom.

Once upon a time, there lived a mommy and a daddy and a little girl named Lucy.

One day, Lucy's mommy was mail-ing a letter to her friend. But when Lucy saw the mail, she wanted to mail something too. So she asked her mommy if she could mail her toy truck. Her mommy said yes and helped Lucy put the toy in the mailbox.

After a while, Mommy and Daddy had to go to the store. But before they left, Mommy put dinner in the dishwasher.

When they got back home, Mommy and Daddy noticed that the dishwasher was hurt. They opened the dishwasher and saw that Lucy's toy truck was inside. 

Dad asked Lucy why the toy truck was in the dishwasher. Lucy said she wanted to mail it by mistake. 

Mommy and Daddy hugged Lucy and said it was an honest mistake. They were very happy that the toy truck wasn't hurt. 

Then, they all ate dinner and went to bed. Lucy was so glad she still had her toy truck.

Once upon a time, there were two best friends named Tom and Jane. Tom and Jane were both three years old and liked playing together.

One day, Tom wanted to go on an adventure. Jane was worried but Tom told her he would be all right. So off they went.

As they explored, Tom noticed something shiny and sparkling in the grass. Tom reached for it and realized it was a sparkling stone. He held it in his hand and showed it to Jane.

But Jane still worried. â€œBe careful. It could be dangerous,â€ she warned.

Jane was grateful that Tom was so helpful. "Thanks, Tom!" She said, relieved.

Tom grinned and they resumed their adventure. They had a lot of fun that day, and Tom still has the sparkling stone.

Once upon a time there was a rat. His name was Peter and he was very brave. One day, Peter started to explore the world outside his house. He came across a bottle full of a strange liquid. Peter sniffed it and it smelled bad. He thought it was poison.

Though he was scared, Peter decided to drink a drop. Suddenly, the poison tasted sweet! Peter was so surprised that he dropped the bottle and it broke. From the poison spilled out a rare gem.

Peter was so excited that he started jumping up and down. A nearby rabbit watched him curiously.

The rabbit asked, "What happened? Why are you so happy?"

Peter smiled and said, "I found something very special. It's a rare gem that I found in the bottle of poison I drank!"

Once there was a baby bear named Benny. He was glad he was out in the woods with his mom and dad. His mom and dad told him a story of how their family had been around for a long time. Benny loved the story!

But then one day, Benny noticed something was strange. He saw a bunny hop away with one of his mom's favourite blankets! Benny was so surprised that he had been so soft and sneakily stolen it.

He told his mom and dad what he had saw. "That bunny was so naughty!" his dad said. Mom agreed and said, "We should go look for our blanket." They all agreed and went searching for it.

After looking around for a little bit, Benny finally spotted the bunny with his blanket! He told his mom and dad, "There it is!" They saw the bunny and chased after it. Finally after a lot of running, they caught the bunny and got their blanket back!

"Now that bunny won't steal anything else," Mom said. Benny smiled and was glad the story had a happy ending!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Holly. Holly was three years old and loved to play. All day long she banged her toys and sang happy songs. 

One day, Holly's mother said to her, "Come on, Holly, it's time to shut the door". Holly did as she was told and shut the door. 

Holly's mother continued, "Now Holly, I'm going to go to the university to learn lots of new things. I'll be back in a few hours." Holly nodded happily. 

As Holly's mother walked away, she shouted back,"Be good, Holly,. I'll be back soon!"

Holly waved goodbye, then watched as her mum walked fast down the street. Holly smiled and thought to herself, "I'll be good, I promise!"

The new pilot felt excited. She was finally going to fly her first plane! She put on her pilot hat and buckle her seatbelt.

"Ready for take-off?" asked Grandpa. He was coming along with her today.

"Yes!" She smiled.

The plane began to move. Faster and faster it went until it left the ground. The pilot felt happy.

"Woah, look at that!" said Grandpa, pointing down. The pilot looked and saw big farms, houses and a river.

"Look! We can wave to the people," Grandpa said. The pilot waved to the people below and smiled.

The plane flew for a while until it was time to land. Grandpa and the pilot felt proud.

"That was awesome!" said Grandpa.

"Yes," said the happy pilot, "flying a plane is the best!"
